title: Browser-only demo in TypeScript; modules meet only at contracts/
context: A hackathon demo has to run reliably on one laptop with possibly no network, and four lanes must integrate late without surprises.
decision: Everything the demo needs runs in the browser. Lanes write TypeScript modules (onboarding/, sensing/, reps/) that the app in app/ imports through the types and API in contracts/. Profiles and rep logs persist locally in the browser. Network calls are allowed for the onboarding conversation model only, with a scripted fallback. The experience lane picks the bundler and records it (default Vite).
alternatives: Native mobile: slower to build, Web Bluetooth not needed
Backend service: adds hosting and auth with no demo benefit
consequences: The Web Bluetooth strap path requires Chrome or Edge on desktop or Android.
author: claude (coord)
